# `native_legal_references`

**Native legal-reference observations**

Original legal references and source passages with character-offset spans in readable text beside positional XPath and recorded target matches. Inspect every candidate's complete keys, target pin, match count and reason. Found, missing, ambiguous, unsupported and not-checked remain separate. Source paths, rendition offsets and interpretation rules stay visible. A complete read replaces its selected source/edition scope, including a successful empty correction. U.S. Code section matches identify held OLRC release-point sections or range stubs under selected-target-lookup/2 (or legacy classification rows on carried /1 scopes), not Code text or current legal applicability.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Selected retained U.S. Code, eCFR, bill, law and Statutes at Large XML inputs only. Read scopes state the edition, input digest, text rendition and forms checked; they do not establish source-wide completeness. *(measured 2026-11-27)*

- **Parquet file:** `native_legal_references.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scope_id` | `VARCHAR` | The input's replacement scope, `native_reference_scope_id` over source_family, source_record_key and edition; a complete read replaces every row of its scope, and a successful empty read clears it. |
| `source_family` | `VARCHAR` | The scanner family that read the input: `uscode`, `ecfr`, `bill`, `law` or `statute`, fixed by the shaper. |
| `source_record_key` | `VARCHAR` | The caller's record identity for the input, retained literally. |
| `edition` | `VARCHAR` | The edition or request date the caller's checked capture metadata states, literally; NULL when it states none, never read from a filename. |
| `body_version_id` | `VARCHAR` | `sha256:` digest of the exact retained XML bytes the scanner read. |
| `source_locator` | `VARCHAR` | Where the caller retained the input from, literally; not proof of acquisition time or edition. |
| `occurrence_index` | `BIGINT` | The observation's zero-based position among the input's observations, both kinds counted together in the order the scanner reported them, as decimal text. |
| `source_path` | `VARCHAR` | The observed element's positional XPath in the input (`/*[1]/*[2]`), never a byte offset. |
| `element_tag` | `VARCHAR` | The observed element's tag, its namespace expanded (`{http://xml.house.gov/schemas/uslm/1.0}ref`) where the input declares one. |
| `observation_kind` | `VARCHAR` | `native_reference` for a bill, law or Statutes at Large observation, `native_reference` or `source_credit` for a U.S. Code observation, `authority` (AUTH) or `source_note` (SOURCE) for an eCFR note. |
| `href` | `VARCHAR` | The element's href exactly as stated, an empty string when stated empty; NULL when absent, and on every source credit and note. |
| `text` | `VARCHAR` | The complete decoded text of a source credit or note, whitespace kept; NULL on a native reference. |
| `text_runs` | `VARCHAR[]` | An eCFR note's text split at element boundaries, as a Native list whose strings join to text; NULL on U.S. Code rows. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct. |
| `cfr_title` | `VARCHAR` | The CFR title the caller's checked capture metadata states, on an eCFR note; NULL when it states none, never inferred from a fragment. |
| `cfr_part` | `VARCHAR` | The `N` of the nearest enclosing DIV5 part on an eCFR note; NULL when no part encloses it, and on U.S. Code rows. |
| `interpretation_status` | `VARCHAR` | How the reading under rule_version read this observation: `native_section_href`, `native_statute_href`, `native_public_law_href` or `unsupported_href` for an href, `native_bill_usc_cite` for a qualified bill DTD cite, `partial_text_findings` or `no_qualified_text_findings` for text; it does not claim exhaustive extraction. |
| `target_candidates` | `STRUCT(candidate_ordinal BIGINT, cite_kind VARCHAR, normalized_key VARCHAR, matched_text VARCHAR, span_start BIGINT, span_end BIGINT, rendition_span_start BIGINT, rendition_span_end BIGINT, target_kind VARCHAR, target_key VARCHAR, target_grain VARCHAR, candidate_keys STRUCT(target_key_ordinal BIGINT, bill_id VARCHAR, congress VARCHAR, law_type VARCHAR, number VARCHAR, "session" VARCHAR, seq VARCHAR, usc_title VARCHAR, usc_section_key VARCHAR, package_id VARCHAR, granule_id VARCHAR, document_number VARCHAR, publication_date VARCHAR, rin VARCHAR, agenda_edition VARCHAR, report_id VARCHAR, docket_id VARCHAR, system_code VARCHAR, cluster_id VARCHAR)[], derivation_rule VARCHAR, derivation_version VARCHAR, document_key VARCHAR, document_kind VARCHAR, expected_cardinality VARCHAR, match_count BIGINT, occurrence_key VARCHAR, reason VARCHAR, resolution_rule VARCHAR, source_record_key VARCHAR, source_status VARCHAR, target_resolved BOOLEAN, target_snapshot STRUCT(status VARCHAR, sha256 VARCHAR, "family" VARCHAR, artifact_digest VARCHAR, generation_id VARCHAR, receipt_sha256 VARCHAR), target_status VARCHAR, target_table_selected VARCHAR, text_sha256 VARCHAR, match_basis VARCHAR, error_type VARCHAR)[]` | The typed targets the reading found, as a Native list in reading order, each with the outcome of the host's lookup in the target tables it selected; several targets in one note stay one row, and an unsupported href has none. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct. |
| `rule_version` | `VARCHAR` | `native-legal-reference/004` (`NATIVE_LEGAL_REFERENCE_RULE`): the scanners' selected shapes and the reading this row was produced under, comparable for equality only. |
| `text_rendition` | `VARCHAR` | The named readable-text rendition into which text_span_start and text_span_end index (`uslm-block-boundaries/1`, `ecfr-block-boundaries/1`, or `bill-dtd-block-boundaries/1`); NULL when no text map was produced. |
| `text_offset_unit` | `VARCHAR` | The offset unit of text_span_start and text_span_end: `unicode_code_points` (0-based half-open code-point indices in text_rendition); NULL when text_rendition is NULL. |
| `text_rendition_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | `sha256:` digest of the UTF-8 encoding of the complete text_rendition string, binding the offsets to the exact rendition beside input_sha256 and source_path; NULL when text_rendition is NULL. |
| `text_span_start` | `BIGINT` | Inclusive 0-based start offset of the observed element's text in text_rendition, as decimal text in text_offset_unit; NULL when the element carries no text or no text map was produced. |
| `text_span_end` | `BIGINT` | Exclusive 0-based end offset of the observed element's text in text_rendition, as decimal text in text_offset_unit, so slicing text_rendition yields span_text; NULL when text_span_start is NULL. |
| `span_text` | `VARCHAR` | The exact slice of text_rendition at [text_span_start:text_span_end] for this element; NULL when text_span_start is NULL. |
| `native_element_id` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher element identifier attached to this legal reference. |
| `native_idref` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher identifier reference attached to this legal reference. |
| `native_class` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher classification attached to this legal reference. |
